metadata.description: CLI Agent Orchestrator (CAO) Agent Plugins: drive multi-agent sessions, contribute to CAO, and author AG-UI and Agent Plugins packages.

plugins.name: cao
plugins.description: Drive CLI Agent Orchestrator multi-agent sessions from any Agent-Plugins-compatible client. Prerequisites: the `uv` toolchain must be on PATH (the MCP server is launched via `uvx`), and a CAO API server must be running locally at http://127.0.0.1:9889 (`cao-server`). All communication is localhost-only.

plugins.name: cao-contributor
plugins.description: Skills for extending CLI Agent Orchestrator: authoring providers and event plugins, and working on the repo itself (dev loop, CI gates, dependency and lockfile rules). Development-facing; install the `cao` plugin instead to drive sessions.

plugins.name: cao-agent-plugin-lifecycle
plugins.description: Skills for the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package lifecycle: author a new package from an empty directory (the plugin.json manifest, skills/ and an optional mcp.json), and audit an existing one against the vendored schemas and the Agent Skills limits that CAO's own validator only warns about. The audit skill bundles a validator that needs no CAO install and opens no network connection itself; its first run needs its dependencies available.

plugins.name: cao-ag-ui-builder
plugins.description: Emit-side AG-UI vocabulary for CLI Agent Orchestrator: the six allow-listed generative-UI components (approval_card, choice_prompt, diff_summary, progress, metric, agent_card) an agent sends with emit_ui, carried as CUSTOM `cao.generative_ui` frames. Describes CAO `main`; no released version carries this yet (#1198). Needs a local cao-server with the [agui] extra. No mcp.json.
